title: SLIC Protocol
author: N.J. Hillson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6t3heqn

steps.title: Measure DNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the DNA concentration (ng/ml) of each assembly piece.

steps.title: Prepare Chew-back Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mg of each assembly piece, including the linearized vector backbone, to separate 20 ml chew-back reaction mixtures.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1 mg assembly piece, 0.1 ml 5 U/ml T4 DNA polymerase, and 2 ml 10X Promega ligase buffer
Add dH2O to reach a total volume of 20 ml

steps.title: Incubate and Arrest Chew-back
steps.instruction: Incubate the chew-back reactions at room temperature and then stop the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes (optimal for 20 bp overhangs)
Arrest the chew-back by adding 2 ml 10 mM dCTP

steps.title: Assemble DNA Pieces
steps.instruction: Combine the chewed-back pieces on ice into a 15 ml total volume assembly reaction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ng of the chewed-back linearized vector backbone
Add equimolar amounts of the other chewed-back assembly pieces
Add 1X Promega ligase buffer to reach a total volume of 15 ml

steps.title: Incubate Assembly Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the assembly reaction at 37 C for 30 minutes, then place on ice.

steps.title: Transform and Verify
steps.instruction: Transform the assembly reaction into competent cells or verify via gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Transform 5 ml of the assembly reaction into 100 ml of competent E. coli
Alternatively, run a diagnostic agarose gel to check for successful assembly
